title: 12.8 Solids of Revolution

icans: I can name the solid formed by rotating a figure around an axis.
I can tell which measures become the radius and the height.
I can find the volume of a solid of revolution.

vocab: a ____________________ figure formed by rotating a two-dimensional shape around an axis
the line around which the shape is __________

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Basic solids of revolution: a rectangle rotated around one side makes a _______________; a right triangle rotated around a leg makes a _______________; a semicircle rotated around its diameter makes a _______________.

blocks.stem:
Name the solid formed by rotating each figure around the given axis.
a.  a rectangle around one of its sides
b.  a right triangle around one of its legs
c.  a semicircle around its diameter

notes: Radius and height: the side on the axis becomes the _______________; the side perpendicular to the axis becomes the _______________.

blocks.stem: The rectangle is rotated around the side on the axis. Find the volume of the solid. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A right triangle with legs of 6 (on the axis) and 4 is rotated around the axis. Find the volume of the solid. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A semicircle with a radius of 3 is rotated around its diameter. Find the volume of the solid. Round to the nearest hundredth.

tickets.stem: What solid is formed when a right triangle is rotated around one of its legs?
A 2-by-6 rectangle is rotated around its side of length 6. Find the volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.
